referenceMethod: Public official documentation read; authenticated variants not exercised

surfaces.implementedScope: Persistent/Temporary chats, streaming/stop, edit/retry/regenerate/branch, rich rendering, search/pins/archive/restore and explicit cloud-history migration.

surfaces.implementedScope: Drafts, keyboard/paste/drop, formatted paste and large-paste attachments; PDF/Office extraction, images and explicit Library reuse.
surfaces.boundary: Supported parsers and size/type limits apply. No audio/video transcription, recording or arbitrary media ingestion claim.

surfaces.implementedScope: Current Kova mode catalog, exact server plan/model access and Work reasoning choices from signed provider capabilities.
surfaces.boundary: Luna/Terra/Sol are the owner-selected lineup. GPT-6 Astra is an audited reference update, not an authorized automatic model migration. Unsupported effort rejects; speed is not a latency guarantee.

surfaces.implementedScope: Source preferences, research plan, bounded live search/synthesis, progress/cancel, persisted evidence/report and exports with current authorization.
surfaces.boundary: Provider-native paused/resumable runs and live redirection are not exposed by the current configured adapter. A provider contract is needed before promising those semantics; existing partial results are not a resumed provider run.

surfaces.implementedScope: CRUD, pause/resume/history, anchored timezone/DST recurrence, conditions, verified native Gmail/Slack/GitHub event ingress, saved/connected context and recipient-authorized copies.
surfaces.boundary: Runtime heartbeat/policy, current OAuth grant/resource access, provider budget and native callback/watch readiness gate execution. Saved chat context is an explicit bounded snapshot, not continuously synchronized history; no credentials are copied.

surfaces.implementedScope: Project lifecycle, files/instructions/memory/chats, current member roles, revision-aware comments/presence, templates and explicit sharing.

surfaces.implementedScope: Saved memory controls, prompt-source inspection, scoped preferences, current-source authorization, themes/language and bounded semantic workspace retrieval.
surfaces.boundary: Search considers bounded accessible records/snippets; it is not an unlimited whole-document index. Semantic fallback labels the mode used. Native Computer History and proprietary ranking are outside web scope.

surfaces.boundary: No arbitrary host shell, package installation, host filesystem/network access or unlimited notebook environment. Deploy pinned sandbox image/runtime and pass real hosted container acceptance.
